department_heads.hod: Head of Department (HOD) - BCA & Course Coordinators
department_heads.year: BCA 1st Year (First Year), BCA 2nd Year, BCA 3rd Year
department_heads.description: The BCA (Bachelor of Computer Applications) Department at VSICS Kanpur is managed by the BCA Head of Department (HOD) and Course Coordinators for BCA 1st Year (First Year), 2nd Year, and 3rd Year. Academic Leadership is led by Executive Director Prof.(Dr.) Arpit Awasthi, Head of Research & FDP Dr. Rekha Nath Singh, and Administrative Heads Mr. Viresh Saxena and Mr. Sunil Saxena.

The MCA (Master of Computer Applications) Department at VSICS Kanpur is managed by the MCA Head of Department (HOD) and Postgraduate Coordinators under Executive Director Prof.(Dr.) Arpit Awasthi and Head of Research & FDP Dr. Rekha Nath Singh.

department_heads.year: BBA 1st Year, BBA 2nd Year, BBA 3rd Year
department_heads.description: The BBA (Bachelor of Business Administration) Department at VSICS Kanpur is managed by the BBA Head of Department (HOD) and Management Coordinators under Executive Director Prof.(Dr.) Arpit Awasthi.
The MBA (Master of Business Administration) Department at VSICS Kanpur is managed by the MBA Head of Department (HOD) and Management Coordinators under Executive Director Prof.(Dr.) Arpit Awasthi.

MCA.name: Master of Computer Applications
MCA.description: The Master of Computer Applications (MCA) is a two-year professional postgraduate program designed for students who wish to gain advanced knowledge and expertise in computer applications, software development, and modern programming technologies.
MCA.eligibility: Passed BCA/Bachelor Degree in Computer Science Engineering or equivalent Degree. OR Passed B.Sc./B.Com./B.A. with Mathematics at 10+2 Level or at Graduation Level.
key_highlights: Well Equipped Computer Labs For Practical Learning
Use Of ICT Tools For Enhanced Learning Exposure

MBA.name: Master of Business Administration
MBA.description: The Master of Business Administration (MBA) program is designed to equip students with the knowledge, skills, and leadership qualities required to meet the evolving demands of business, industry, and commerce.

BCA.name: Bachelor of Computer Applications
BCA.description: The BCA program provides students with a strong foundation in computer applications, programming, software development, and emerging technologies.

BBA.name: Bachelor of Business Administration
BBA.description: The BBA program is a comprehensive professional course designed to provide students with a strong foundation in managerial concepts and business practices.

fees.payment_mode: Fees are accepted ONLY online via UPI, Net Banking, and Direct Bank Transfer. Cash payments are not accepted. All fees are Non-Refundable.
fees.document_verification_fee: Rs. 1000 for Background Verifying Companies (Executive Director VSICS CA A/C: 6465173743)

statistics.highest_package: Rs. 1.5 Crores at Microsoft (Ankita Tripathi - BCA), Rs. 1 Crore at CampKey Healthcare UK (Amber Shukla - MBA), Rs. 60 LPA at Protiviti & IBM US (MCA)

events.title: SRIJAN 2026 - Annual Inter-College Tech & Cultural Fest
events.location: VSICS Main Campus Auditorium & Sports Grounds
events.highlights: Inter-college coding hackathon, web development challenge, e-sports gaming tournament (BGMI/Valorant), Western & Indian group dance, fashion runway, and management quiz.
events.awards: Trophies and certificates for all winners & participants.

events.title: CodeForge V2 - 24-Hour Web & AI Hackathon
events.highlights: Build real-world web apps and AI solutions with industry mentors from IBM and TCS.

events.title: Khelotsav 2026 - Annual Campus Sports Meet
events.highlights: Inter-departmental tournaments in Cricket, Football, Volleyball, Badminton, Table Tennis, Chess, and Athletics 100m/400m races.
events.awards: Overall Champions Trophy & Best Athlete Medals.

events.title: Freshers Party 2026 - Grand Freshers Welcome Party
events.highlights: Welcome gala for 1st Year BCA, MCA, BBA, and MBA students featuring Mr. & Ms. Fresher contest, music performances, and DJ night.

events.title: CyberSecurity & Cloud Infrastructure Masterclass
events.highlights: Hands-on workshop by certified ethical hackers and Cloud Architects from HCLTech & Accenture.

events.title: Blood Donation Camp & Green Campus Drive
events.highlights: Annual Blood Donation Camp in association with GSVM Medical College, Tree Plantation Drive, and Digital Literacy Outreach.

infrastructure.lecture_halls: 30 well designed Lecture Halls with a standard sitting capacity of 70 students at a time, equipped with LCD and modern gadgets (few air-conditioned).
infrastructure.library: Well stocked library with more than 2,000 titles in over 11,000 multiple copies, regularly updated with Indian and overseas titles.
infrastructure.seminar_halls: 3 Seminar halls with seating capacity of 150 utilized for Seminars, Conferences, Guest Lectures, Group Discussions, and Debates.
infrastructure.computer_labs: 8 Computer Labs equipped with more than 400 Pentium IV/Core computers networked through Linux/NT servers with high-speed Internet access.
infrastructure.sports_facilities: Compound field for Football, Cricket, Hockey, Boxing, Athletics, Badminton & Handball courts, plus an indoor games room for Chess, Carrom, and Table Tennis.

admission.criteria: Admissions governed by AKTU / CSJMU counseling guidelines and merit criteria.

scholarships.details: Government scholarship and fee reimbursement scheme for eligible SC/ST/OBC/EWS category students as per U.P. Govt norms.
